gaps.sentence: The concert tickets sold ___ within an hour.
gaps.explanation: sell out = all tickets/goods are sold.

gaps.sentence: During the tour she pointed ___ the oldest house in town.
gaps.explanation: point out = mention/draw attention to a fact.

gaps.sentence: Don't worry — he always turns ___ late.
gaps.explanation: turn up = arrive, often unexpectedly or late.

gaps.sentence: The strike brought ___ major changes in the law.
The police are cracking ___ on unlicensed street vendors.
gaps.explanation: 'Crack down on' = deal firmly with illegal behaviour.

gaps.sentence: Don't ___ up all the milk — we need some for breakfast.
gaps.explanation: use up = finish the whole supply of something.

gaps.sentence: The band broke ___ in the middle of the song.
We had to call ___ the order because the kitchen had closed.
